project.name: Multimodal Narcotics Screening AI
project_focus: qualified human review and audit trails

strategy: Free-first, local-first, evidence-first advanced AI and robotics roadmap.

execution_policy.note: CI uses Python standard library for this registry audit. Existing project workflows and dependencies are not modified.

technology_candidates.name: Qdrant
technology_candidates.purpose: optional local vector retrieval for evidence search

capabilities.name: Multimodal perception and sensor fusion
capabilities.description: Images, text, audio and sensor streams; missing and conflicting modalities must remain explicit. Existing foundation identified; this does not imply a complete or validated capability.

capabilities.name: World-state model and temporal event tracking
capabilities.description: Track entities, locations, timestamps, state changes and stale observations; never invent missing state. Existing foundation identified; this does not imply a complete or validated capability.

capabilities.name: Uncertainty, abstention and calibration
capabilities.description: Expose confidence limits, calibration status and UNKNOWN/REVIEW_REQUIRED outcomes. Existing foundation identified; this does not imply a complete or validated capability.

capabilities.name: Digital twin and physics-based simulation
capabilities.description: Use reproducible synthetic scenarios; simulation results are not field validation. Existing foundation identified; this does not imply a complete or validated capability.

capabilities.name: SLAM, mapping and autonomous navigation
capabilities.description: Optional robotics integration; only activate with a compatible simulator/hardware profile and safety review.

capabilities.name: Motion, manipulation and mission planning
capabilities.description: Generate plans and safety constraints; no direct hardware actuation from this audit system. Existing foundation identified; this does not imply a complete or validated capability.

capabilities.name: Predictive fault and anomaly detection
capabilities.description: Monitor sensor freshness, communication, battery and system-health signals where available.

capabilities.name: Tool-using agents and supervised workflows
capabilities.description: Agents may propose and evaluate tasks; require allowlisted tools, bounded actions and human approval for consequential actions. Existing foundation identified; this does not imply a complete or validated capability.

capabilities.name: Multi-agent and multi-robot coordination
capabilities.description: Research/simulation only until communication, arbitration and fail-safe behaviour are validated.

capabilities.name: Safety verification and fail-safe decision gates
capabilities.description: Fail closed on missing or invalid safety signals; retain emergency-stop priority and human override.

capabilities.name: Offline/local model inference adapters
capabilities.description: Optional only; no model download or runtime activation by CI; check memory, hardware and license first.

capabilities.name: Evidence provenance and reproducible reports
capabilities.description: Record source, timestamp, version, dataset split, metric, test conditions and limitations. Existing foundation identified; this does not imply a complete or validated capability.

safety_boundary.model_and_simulation_claims: No capability is considered implemented or validated solely because it appears in this registry.
safety_boundary.project_specific_limitations: AI outputs are non-diagnostic screening leads only. They must not identify a person as guilty, establish chemical identity, or independently trigger detention, search, denial of service or enforcement action. Qualified human review and validated instruments remain mandatory.

reporting.verified_requires: Reproducible test evidence, defined metrics, dataset/test conditions, review and an evidence reference.
